normative_extracts.spec_section: 10.5 Proxy Object Internal Methods and Internal Slots
normative_extracts.quote: A Proxy exotic object delegates [[Get]] and [[Set]] internal methods to user-defined trap functions on the handler object before forwarding to [[ProxyTarget]].

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Runtime proxies intercept property access dynamically via V8 exotic object traps, while static compilers transform assignments at build time into direct signal or bitmask updates.

production_failures.symptom: Dropped frames and GC spikes when rendering large data tables
production_failures.root_cause: Deeply wrapping 10,000+ immutable API rows in ES6 Proxies allocates thousands of wrapper objects and defeats V8 inline caches.
production_failures.mitigation: Use shallow reactive containers or mark large read-only datasets raw so they bypass recursive Proxy wrapping.

production_failures.symptom: UI stops updating after refactoring component props
production_failures.root_cause: Destructuring a reactive Proxy outside a tracked computation evaluates the [[Get]] trap once and holds a stale primitive.
production_failures.mitigation: Read reactive properties directly inside tracked expressions or compile-time getter wrappers.
